Fixed `TopModule.sv` by correcting the FSM state encoding at `TopModule.sv:8`. I also sanity-checked the overlap case `10110111` with `iverilog -g2012`/`vvp`; `flag` now pulses twice, one cycle after each `1011` detection as required.

SYMPTOM: overlapping `1011` detection failed because the FSM could not distinguish the `S2` (“10”) and `S3` (“101”) states, so `flag` was asserted at the wrong times or missed detections  
ROOT CAUSE: `TopModule.sv:8` defined `S3=2`, the same encoding as `S2=2`; this collapsed two different FSM states into one, breaking the transition from “10” to “101” to “1011”  
FIX: changed the state encoding at `TopModule.sv:8` from `S3=2` to `S3=3` so each FSM state has a unique value
